title: Coherent response circuit challenge
description: Submit a cheaper exact coherent response circuit, a universal lower bound or a resource-model correction against the declared production response-cost premise.
acceptance: The submission must bind to the exact production response relation and declared reversible cost model. Schema and source pins are checked automatically. A maintainer may accept a rigorous inconclusive result with no effects; changing a claim or frontier requires the full two-reviewer equivalence and resource-accounting policy.
